sn56.62:1.1: atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsuṃ āropetvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
sn56.62:1.3: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ, yo vā’yaṃ mayā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito, ayaṃ vā mahāpaṭhavī”ti?
sn56.62:1.4: etadeva bhante, bahutaraṃ yadidaṃ mahāpaṭhavī, appamattakoyaṃ bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito.
sn56.62:1.5: saṅkhampi na upeti, upanidhimpi na upeti, kalabhāgampi na upeti mahāpaṭhaviṃ upanidhāya bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropitoti.
